decisions.decision: Use a newly created, dedicated AWS Organizations member account as the project trust anchor

decisions.rationale: AWS supports service monitors in member accounts; linked-account monitors are management-account-only.

decisions.rationale: Organization Cost Explorer is enabled by the management account; only management accounts can manage cost-allocation tags.
